description: Admin app-state dashboard for lopii-finance-bot: app health, LLM health + tokens, intent quality, domain/business. Reads request_traces, llm_calls, intent_events and domain tables. Pick a Postgres datasource at import time.

spec.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - max(received_at)))::int AS secs FROM request_traces

spec.description: Segundos desde el último request_trace. Alto = el bot no está recibiendo updates.
spec.title: Heartbeat — seg desde último update

spec.rawSql: SELECT min(ratelimit_remaining_tokens) AS min_tok FROM llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at,$__interval) AS time, call_type, count(*) AS value FROM llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, call_type ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at,$__interval) AS time, call_type, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS value FROM llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, call_type ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at,$__interval) AS time, sum(prompt_tokens) AS prompt, sum(completion_tokens) AS completion, sum(total_tokens) AS total FROM llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT model, count(*) AS calls, count(*) FILTER (WHERE attempts > 1) AS retries FROM llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY model ORDER BY calls DESC

spec.description: Distribución de calls por modelo en el rango. Reintentos = attempts > 1.
spec.title: Mix de modelos (calls) + reintentos

spec.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome = 'abandoned')/NULLIF(count(*),0),2) AS abandon_pct FROM intent_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

spec.description: outcome = abandoned (flow murió sin terminal). Fricción / bugs de flow.
spec.title: Abandono %

spec.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome LIKE '%cancelled%')/NULLIF(count(*),0),2) AS cancel_pct FROM intent_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT count(*) AS pending FROM intent_events WHERE outcome = 'pending'

spec.description: Filas pending sin resolver. Alto = flows colgados. Sin filtro de tiempo (estado actual).
spec.title: Pending backlog (ahora)

spec.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE was_correct)/NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE was_correct IS NOT NULL),0),2) AS accuracy_pct FROM intent_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

spec.description: was_correct todavía no tiene writer en el código — panel placeholder hasta que se implemente la señal de corrección.
spec.title: Accuracy % (sin datos aún)

spec.rawSql: SELECT intent, count(*) AS n FROM intent_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY intent ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT count(*) AS updates FROM request_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)
SELECT outcome, count(*) AS n FROM intent_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY outcome ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at,$__interval) AS time, outcome, count(*) AS value FROM intent_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, outcome ORDER BY 1
SELECT 1 AS up
SELECT count(*) AS users FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) AS dau FROM request_traces WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND received_at > now() - interval '24 hours'

spec.description: Usuarios distintos con actividad en las últimas 24h (request_traces). Ventana fija, no depende del time picker.
spec.title: DAU (24h)

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) AS wau FROM request_traces WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND received_at > now() - interval '7 days'
SELECT count(*) AS movements FROM movements WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT count(*) AS accounts FROM accounts WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at,$__interval) AS time, count(*) AS new_users FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at,$__interval) AS time, count(*) AS movements FROM movements WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE error <> '')/NULLIF(count(*),0),2) AS error_pct FROM request_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)
SELECT count(*) AS zombies FROM conversation_states WHERE updated_at < now() - interval '1 hour'

spec.description: conversation_states sin tocar hace > 1h. Flows abiertos que quedaron colgados.
spec.title: Zombie flows

spec.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS enabled FROM reminders WHERE enabled
SELECT 'llm_calls' AS tabla, count(*) AS filas FROM llm_calls UNION ALL SELECT 'request_traces', count(*) FROM request_traces UNION ALL SELECT 'intent_events', count(*) FROM intent_events

spec.description: Row counts de llm_calls / request_traces. Si crecen sin parar, el Sweeper de retención no está corriendo.
spec.title: Tamaño tablas métricas (retención)

spec.rawSql: SELECT round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms)) AS p95_ms FROM request_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(received_at,$__interval) AS time, update_type, count(*) AS value FROM request_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1, update_type ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(received_at,$__interval) AS time, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p95, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p99 FROM request_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE error <> '' OR http_status >= 400)/NULLIF(count(*),0),2) AS llm_error_pct FROM llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms)) AS p95_ms FROM llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT min(ratelimit_remaining_requests) AS min_req FROM llm_calls WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

spec.description: Menor headroom de requests de Groq en el rango. Bajo = cerca de throttling.
spec.title: Rate-limit — min requests restantes
